check: demo build: ends after 2 won battles with a demo-complete screen; demo vs full-run save
commit: 6e98bfb (game code; QA recorder scene scenes/tests/record_clip.gd added in the evidence commit)
platform: Linux x86_64 container, Xvfb + Mesa llvmpipe (software GL), gl_compatibility

linux_demo.note: export_presets.cfg has no Linux demo preset. For this check a scratch copy of the commit got two extra presets, 'Linux QA' (no feature) and 'Linux Demo QA' (custom_features=demo), both identical to the repo's 'Linux' preset except that scenes/tests/ is not excluded (so the QA driver scene ships in the pck). Nothing in the repo's export_presets.cfg was changed.

runs.expected: Web Demo export loads in Chromium and shows the title menu with the DEMO tag
runs.observed: menu reached after 27s, 0 script errors; screenshot shows 'DEMO · first two battles'

runs.expected: a full-mode run saved after battle 1
runs.observed: save run_id LR-00000005 mode=full phase=reward battles_won=1

runs.expected: (open question) what the demo build does with a full-run save
runs.observed: the demo build (feature demo = True) loads the full run via Continue: run mode 'full', battles_won 1. Nothing in the demo stops a full run from being continued past battle 2 in the demo build. File unchanged because no command was sent.

runs.command: XDG_DATA_HOME=$X xvfb-run -a builds/linux_demo_qa/Lastroot.x86_64 --rendering-method gl_compatibility --resolution 1280x720 --write-movie demo.avi --fixed-fps 30 res://scenes/tests/record_clip.tscn -- --new_run=SPORE --seed=7 --autoplay=3 --max_seconds=400 --end_hold=4 --shot_on_end=demo_complete.png --log=...
runs.expected: demo run ends after 2 won battles (phase won, result demo_complete) with the 'End of the demo' screen; the full-run save must survive
runs.observed: mode=demo, battles_won=2, phase=won, result=demo_complete at 60.7 s (bot asked for 3 battles; the run stopped at 2). Result screen 'End of the demo' with 'In the full game' panel. All 6 end turns matched the forecast. Save file before: run LR-00000005 mode full; after: run LR-00000007 mode demo. run.json and run.backup.json no longer hold the full run.
runs.status: PASS (demo limit + end screen); FAIL (full save overwritten)

save_paths_today.desktop_user_dir: ~/.local/share/godot/app_userdata/LASTROOT/ (same for demo and full: same project name, no custom user dir)
save_paths_today.web: user:// is the browser's IndexedDB-backed file system per origin; a Web Demo hosted on the same origin as the full web build would share it (inferred from Godot's web platform, not tested)
save_paths_today.demo_specific: none: GameSession.new_run() only sets run.mode = 'demo'; SaveService writes the same files

summary: Demo limit works in an exported demo build: 2 won battles -> 'End of the demo'. Demo and full game share one save file: a demo New run (after the 'Start a new run?' confirm in the menu, which this driver bypasses) replaces a full-run save and its backup, and the demo build can Continue a full run. LR-34 acceptance 'Demo cannot overwrite a full run save' is NOT met at 6e98bfb; separate demo save paths are being added in save_service.gd by another agent.
